directions: Melt butter and stir together with honey.
Combine all cereals and snacks in a large bowl or roasting pan.
Pour honey butter mixture over the cereal mixture and stir to coat evenly.
Spray 2 cookie sheets or a large pan and spread mixture out.
Bake at 350°F for 25 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.
After baking, pour mix onto parchment paper to prevent clumping. Let cool.
